text: Your membership, fees and refunds at your gym are between you and your gym.
page: Terms of use, In short
proof: Design comment only (payProviders.js:3: the money always goes to the gym's own account; MettleUp only asks 'make a link' and 'was it paid'). The Razorpay link is made with the gym's own keys (payProviders.js:112-116, code). The adapter list has no refund call (payProviders.js:5-17, comment); the whole file was not read.

text: Payments are not refunded, except a double payment or a payment above the price.
page: Terms of use, In short
proof: unknown (a process promise done by hand). The code only lets HQ confirm or reject a reported payment (supabase/migrations/0060_pay_mettleup.sql:38, :45, header); no refund step or refund record was found there.

text: The app is only for people aged 18 or over.
page: Terms of use, part A section 2
proof: A tick box 'I'm 18 or older...' must be ticked before joining a gym (joinTerms.ts:20-22) and before Google sign-in (joinTerms.ts:59-62); a self-join stores adultAt (0077_self_join.sql:196). It is the person's own word: no age is checked. No tick was found for a person who uses the app without joining a gym or signing in (the first-run screens were not all read).

text: MettleUp is a free workout log for your phone and watch.
page: Terms of use, part A section 3
proof: MEMBER_PLAN_GATE_ON = false (memberPlan.ts:28) and MEMBER_PAYMENTS_LIVE = false (:34): today nothing is locked or sold to a member. Note: a paid tier is already built and switched off (prices at :68; 'watch' is in the paid list at :57). If that switch goes on, 'free ... for your phone and watch' stops being true.

text: If you do not sign in, your workouts are only on your phone, so keep your phone backed up.
page: Terms of use, part A section 5
proof: The cloud copy sends nothing when no account is signed in (copySync.ts:103-106, code). But a phone that joined a gym sends workout summaries whatever the sign-in: a weekly summary for trainers, on by default (0050_trainer_view.sql:4, :14-19, header), and workouts and kg per day for the leaderboard (0037_leaderboard.sql:12-14, header). Not checked: whether a gym join can happen with no sign-in at all.

text: You can download them (Settings → Your data → Backup and restore → "Download my data") or delete them at any time.
page: Terms of use, part A section 5
proof: The path exists as written: group 'Your data' (settingsLines.ts:151), row 'Backup and restore' (:132), row 'Download my data' (:169), page (save-backup.tsx:7). Delete: the server copy is deleted by deleteAccount (account.ts:149-160, code); the on-phone erase is named only in a header comment (settings/data.tsx:1), its code was not read. No test was opened.

text: Your membership, prices, payments and refunds are between you and your gym.
page: Terms of use, part A section 6
proof: Same as P-A7-legal-3-01: design comment (payProviders.js:3) and the link made with the gym's own keys (:112-116). No refund call in the adapter list (:5-17, comment); the whole file was not read.

text: We do not take or hold your money.
page: Terms of use, part A section 6
proof: Payment links are made at the payment company with the gym's own keys (payProviders.js:112-116, code; pay.js:2-3, comment), and the test connects with the gym owner's keys (pay.test.mjs:113-133). Only the Razorpay adapter's first lines were read; Cashfree, PayU, PhonePe and the plain UPI request were not, so no proof that no path sends money to a MettleUp account.

text: Some features exist only if your gym switches them on.
page: Terms of use, part A section 6
proof: Design comments only: a gym owner's switch decides what locks for a member (0070_member_plus_lock.sql:11-14); some features belong to a gym's plan (0062_plan_features.sql:14-16). No code or test was read for this sentence.

text: You can stop using the app, leave your gym or delete your account at any time.
page: Terms of use, part A section 10
proof: Leave gym forgets the gym on the phone at once and tells the server, retried later if offline (gymActions.ts:521-540, code). 'Delete my account' button (AccountCard.tsx:100) calls deleteAccount (account.ts:149-160). Two limits: it needs the internet (components/settings/DataCard.tsx:121, comment), and for an account that is also a gym's sign-in (owner, trainer, older gym-sync member) only the copy is deleted and the sign-in is kept (account.ts:145-147).

text: If you did not sign in and you lose your phone, we cannot bring your workouts back.
page: Terms of use, part A section 11
proof: With no account signed in, the cloud copy queues nothing (copySync.ts:103-106, code), so the server has no workouts to bring back. The gym summaries that do leave the phone (see P-A7-legal-3-05) are totals, not the workouts.

text: Before a change takes effect, we tell you in the app.
page: Terms of use, part A section 12
proof: The terms changed for members on 18 Nov 2026 (terms.html:142, section 4). The member app's terms version is still '2026-11-10' (apps/mobile/src/shop/joinTerms.ts:30), and the tick is only asked at a gym join or a Google sign-in on a phone with no saved tick (joinTerms.ts:44-49, :59-62): a member already using the app is told nothing. The app's What's new has no line about this change (apps/mobile/src/lib/whatsNew.ts: the only lines with 'terms' are :134 and :588; no 'only a guide' or 'qualified trainer' anywhere in apps/mobile/src). Searched: apps/mobile/src only.

text: If you do not agree, stop using it and you can delete your account.
page: Terms of use, part A section 12
proof: Same as P-A7-legal-3-10: deleteAccount (account.ts:149-160) works, but needs the internet and keeps the sign-in of an account that is also a gym's sign-in (account.ts:145-147).

text: We answer within 30 days.
page: Terms of use, part A section 13
proof: unknown (a process promise done by hand; no timer or log for complaints was looked for or found)

text: Every new gym gets 3 months free.
page: Terms of use, part B section 2
proof: The default for a new gym is now + 3 months (0030_plans_and_trials.sql:64-65, code). But the online sign-up gives NO trial (trial ends now) when the checked phone number already had a trial or already owns a gym (0061_phone_codes.sql:169-176, code). So 'every' is not true for a second gym from the same number. Not checked: whether 0061 is live, and later versions of this function. supabase/tests/0030 not opened.

text: When the trial ends, we ask you to pick a plan and pay.
page: Terms of use, part B section 2
proof: After the end the owner's Today screen says 'Your free trial ended on ... Pick a MettleUp pack to keep going.' (trial.ts:94, code). Shown only to the owner of an online gym, and nothing shows if the server call fails (TrialBanner.tsx:5-8, :17-39). No test was opened.

text: Your plan starts or extends when we confirm the payment.
page: Terms of use, part B section 3
proof: HQ's Confirm calls apply_gym_payment (0060_pay_mettleup.sql:297), which sets plan and paid_until (:279); a reported payment stays pending until then (:8-10, header). The file's first line says '(NOT APPLIED)': whether it is live was not checked (no database reads in this step). supabase/tests/0060_pay_mettleup.sql not opened.

text: Once a paid plan is on, payments are not refunded.
page: Terms of use, part B section 4
proof: unknown (a process promise done by hand). No refund function exists in 0060 (header list, supabase/migrations/0060_pay_mettleup.sql:27-49).

text: If you paid twice by mistake, or paid more than the price, we refund the extra amount to the same account.
page: Terms of use, part B section 4
proof: unknown (a process promise done by hand). The code refuses the same reference sent twice (DUPLICATE_REFERENCE, supabase/migrations/0060_pay_mettleup.sql:33, header) but has no refund step and no record that a refund was made.

text: We tell you in the admin app first.
page: Terms of use, part B section 5
proof: For a trial that ended: yes, the owner's Today screen says so (trial.ts:94, code; stronger in the last 14 days, TrialBanner.tsx:3). For a LATE PAYMENT of a paid plan: no notice was found in what was read (the banner is built from the trial, TrialBanner.tsx:17-39); owner_gym_state exists (supabase/migrations/0062_plan_features.sql:51, header) but its screen was not found or read.

text: After that, we may switch off the paid features step by step.
page: Terms of use, part B section 5
proof: The steps are built: 7 days grace, 30 days basic, then read-only (0062_plan_features.sql:20-26, header; packages/theme/src/plans.ts:150-158). The switch is OFF on both sides (0062_plan_features.sql:56 inserts {"on": false}; plans.ts:40 PLAN_GATE_ON = false), so today nothing is switched off. The sentence says 'may', so this matches. supabase/tests/0062_plan_features.sql not opened.

text: We never delete your records because a payment is late, and you can always see and export them.
page: Terms of use, part B section 5
proof: Design comments only for 'never delete' (0062_plan_features.sql:25-26 'read_only: look and download only ... Data is never deleted'; 0030_plans_and_trials.sql:14). The export button exists (GymDataActions.tsx:86-87) and needs the internet. Not proven: that no clean-up job deletes an unpaid gym (0066_purge_qa_gyms.sql not opened), and that export still works in the read-only state (not tested, the gate is off).

text: Your gym is in charge of them, and MettleUp only stores them for you.
page: Terms of use, part B section 6
proof: unknown (a statement of roles; the written agreement exists, but nothing read in this step proves MettleUp uses the records for nothing else)

text: Only the owner can cancel a receipt, with the true reason.
page: Terms of use, part B section 7
proof: Server: a front-desk change to a saved receipt is refused OWNER_ONLY (0019_staff_discount_and_taker.sql:40-45, code; this is the newest _staff_write_ok, called from crm_push at 0024_workout_plans.sql:105). A cancel needs a reason of 3 letters or more, else NEED_REASON (0021_receipt_rules.sql:131-138; same rule re-made in 0041_offline_desk_receipts.sql:38-41). Admin app: voidReceipt is false for staff (permissions.ts:68-70). The code cannot check that the reason is true. Tests not opened.

text: We only ask it to make payment links and to tell us when they are paid.
page: Terms of use, part B section 8
proof: The code asks the payment company for more than these two things: it tests the pasted keys by listing a payment link (payProviders.js:112-115, code), reads a link's state including refunds (:11-13, :149), closes a link (:16) and has a webhook registered (deploy/panel/pay.js:6-7, comment). No charge, refund or payout call is in the adapter list (:5-17, comment). The whole file (533 lines) was not read.

text: We keep your connection keys locked and never show them again.
page: Terms of use, part B section 8
proof: Test opened: 'connect: owner only; keys checked with the company, sealed, and never answered back' (pay.test.mjs:113-133) checks the stored row does not hold the key or secret in plain text and that the desk answer holds neither, only the last 4 characters. What a screen may see never has the keys (pay.js:259-271, code). Sealed with AES-GCM under a Worker secret (deploy/panel/migrations/0011_payments.sql:11, comment).

text: You can also ask us to delete your gym.
page: Terms of use, part B section 9
kept_by: written process: docs/launch/GYM-DELETE.md (named at 0027_hq_actions.sql:28, not opened)
proof: HQ has a delete-request workflow and a delete function (0027_hq_actions.sql:27-28, header; :345, code). No button to ask was found in the admin app (not searched in full); the page gives an email address (terms.html:140).

text: We delete its records within 30 days of your request (section 9 of the data agreement).
page: Terms of use, part B section 9
kept_by: written process: docs/launch/GYM-DELETE.md (named at 0027_hq_actions.sql:28, not opened)
proof: The delete exists and removes every gym table by cascade (0027_hq_actions.sql:340-345). The 30 days depend on a person pressing it after 'called' and 'reminded' (:341, :344); nothing in the code forces the date. Same as P-A7-pilot-23.

text: We may end this agreement with 30 days' notice, or at once for serious misuse.
page: Terms of use, part B section 9
proof: unknown (a process promise; HQ can suspend a gym at once with a reason, supabase/migrations/0027_hq_actions.sql:23, but no 30-day notice step was found)

text: You decide which plans to send, and you can change, delete or add plans at any time.
page: Terms of use, part B section 10
proof: Add and change: saveDiet (DietPlans.tsx:88-96, code). Delete: a diet plan cannot be deleted, only withdrawn ('Nothing is deleted: Withdraw stops it going out', DietPlans.tsx:11; withdrawDiet at :109). It needs the gym online and the internet (:9). Workout plans: no delete was found by a word search of apps/dashboard/src; their screen was not read.

text: Before a new version applies, we tell the owner in the admin app and ask them to accept it again.
page: Terms of use, part B section 13
proof: The page says it changed for gyms on 14 Nov 2026 (new section 10 'Ready-made plans') and again on 18 Nov 2026 (terms.html:142). The admin app still asks for version '2026-11-10' (terms.ts:23) and the server's list ends at '2026-11-10' (supabase/migrations/0067_terms_version_2026_11_10.sql:22; no later migration changes it). An owner is asked again only when their accepted version is older than that (terms.ts:55-58), so an owner who accepted on or after 10 Nov was not asked to accept the 14 Nov or 18 Nov words. The test named at terms.ts:20 was not opened.
